evidenceFindings.finding: Signed constitutional universal adult suffrage, multiparty elections, accountability and supreme constitutional rights; endorses parliamentary investigation.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Direct constitutional endorsement supports this rule; no referendum or recall entitlement is invented.

evidenceFindings.finding: Bill of Rights protects peaceful assembly, expression, privacy, bodily integrity and court-supervised detention subject to justified limits.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified constitutional inference retains reasonable limitations; specific stop/search or tracking rules require separate evidence.

evidenceFindings.finding: Constitution recognizes several official and community languages and cultural rights within equal citizenship.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Plural national identity is inferred from his signed constitutional commitment; migrant-language rules are not equated with Indigenous official languages.

evidenceFindings.finding: GEAR speech endorses varied state-asset restructuring, some privatization, strategic partners, public infrastructure and parastatal investment.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Mixed-ownership inference identifies actual restructuring; strategic/public functions are retained rather than assuming uniform nationalization.

evidenceFindings.finding: Explicitly links tariff reductions and foreign investment to competitiveness and employment while retaining social obligations.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified opening-trade inference does not establish all agriculture, procurement or retaliation exceptions.

evidenceFindings.finding: Uses a macroeconomic investment strategy, targeted incentives and wage moderation rather than comprehensive command production; capital liberalisation was gradual.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified mixed-economy inference preserves steering alongside private production and avoids calling GEAR a complete production plan.

evidenceFindings.finding: Social access and public investment are constitutional/presidential priorities; compensated public-interest land reform is expressly permitted.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified distribution inference separates socioeconomic rights/land restitution from unsupported precise tax or cash-benefit instruments.

evidenceFindings.finding: Constitution guarantees religious freedom; equitable voluntary observances in state institutions are permitted without giving clerics lawmaking power.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified secular-authority inference preserves the actual allowance for public worship.

evidenceFindings.finding: Signed constitutional equality includes sex, marital status and sexual orientation.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified social-recognition inference follows from protected equality, not a claim he legislated same-sex marriage during 1994–99.

evidenceFindings.finding: Environmental right combines conservation with justifiable economic/social development; GEAR promotes housing and infrastructure.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified development tradeoff retains environmental justification and does not imply unrestricted habitat destruction.

evidenceFindings.finding: Mandela assented to the 1999 original Broadcasting Act, whose section 7(8) places 100% of SABC shares in State ownership and section 8 maintains national public broadcasting services.
evidenceFindings.rationale: The specific publicly owned national broadcaster follows from the original Act signed during his presidency; later consolidated amendments are excluded.
